questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Viewing Horstman Glacier from a safe marked area, Flora asks how a glacier can move. Which explanation is correct?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在安全的标记区域观看霍斯特曼冰川，冰川怎样移动？
choices: It moves only when all its ice melts
Its ice deforms and flows under gravity
choices_zh: 必须全部融化后才移动
冰在重力作用下变形并流动
questions.explain_en: Glacier ice can deform and flow slowly under gravity.
questions.explain_zh: 冰川的冰能在重力作用下变形，缓慢流动。
